notes:
On the Serenity Desktop App's 1.13: she answers on Discord as soon as a message comes, and keeps talking as long as you do.

- **Discord messages are answered as they arrive,** not at the next once-a-minute look.
- **No more per-account or per-conversation cap for people,** only your hourly cap and her daily budget. Your own linked Discord account has no cap at all and doesn't count toward the hourly one. Other bots keep both caps, so two bots can't go on forever.
